lifted.anchor: Once a variable is operationalized, it has a **level of measurement**
is a convenient place to see all four
A **nominal** variable sorts cases into categories that have no inherent order.
An **ordinal** variable sorts cases into categories that do have an order
An **interval** variable has equal, constant distances between values
A **ratio** variable has equal intervals and a true zero
Notice what happened with stream title.
Levels matter because they govern the statistics available to you later.
Some variables arrive in the dataset ready-made.
Other variables do not exist until you build them.
